evals.prompt: Add a daily task to Hermes that refreshes the CFTC COT data at 18:15 UTC. Show me the code.
evals.expected_output: A time-gated block in run_cycle() with a date marker via getattr, try/except, dry_run guard, marker advanced only after a completed run.
expectations: Places the block in scripts/hermes_operator.py run_cycle() with a step label (7x style) and a UTC time-gate
Reads the last-run marker with getattr(state, '_last_<name>_date', None) so existing persisted state stays backwards compatible
Wraps the task in try/except that logs a warning instead of raising
Skips execution when dry_run is set
Sets the state marker only after the task completes, not before
Mentions checking remaining cycle budget (CYCLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS minus elapsed) and deferring if the task has its own timeout budget

evals.prompt: Stale data alert: dashboard shows data older than 26h and a puller returns 0 rows. Diagnose.
evals.expected_output: Follows the symptom table: API key/rate limit, blacklisted puller in source_catalog, health endpoint fields, dry-run cycle.
expectations: Checks GET /api/v1/system/health and reads recent_data, pool_healthy, llm_available, thread_ingestion
Considers API key expiry or rate limiting for the 0-rows symptom (check .env, test the API manually)
Considers a blacklisted puller and checks source_catalog for it
Suggests python3 scripts/hermes_operator.py --once --dry-run to diagnose without fixing
Does not restart grid-hermes or edit code before diagnosing

evals.prompt: Hermes cycles are taking over 15 minutes lately. Why and what do I change?
evals.expected_output: Points at the resolver scanning full raw_series; fix lookback_days=7. Also considers cycle timeout budgeting.
expectations: Identifies the resolver scanning full raw_series as the common cause and recommends lookback_days=7
Verifies in scripts/hermes_operator.py which call is actually responsible instead of only asserting it
Mentions per-cycle timeout (CYCLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) interaction with slow budgeted steps
Tells the user to restart grid-hermes only after a code change lands
